transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I guess I'm here because... I just can't shake this feeling. It just keeps looping in my head that... I failed. As a father. And just... as a useful person, really. It gets so loud sometimes that I just start thinking I don't... I don't really deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month, I suppose. Ever since... well, my daughter left for college. Out of state. So... yeah, about a month.
Have you noticed any changes in the things you enjoy doing since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... I used to work on this model railway. And, you know, watch Cubs games with her. But... I haven't really touched any of it lately. The trains are just sitting there half-built on the table. And even just... turning on a game on the TV just feels pointless now.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
No. Not really. Like I said, I... I don't touch the trains anymore. And the games... they just don't matter. There isn't really anything else.
Do you still feel pleasure when you're doing things that normally would bring you happiness, or has that feeling changed for you?

I... I think I just said. It's all changed. I used to really look forward to those things, you know, the railway, the games with her. But... no. There's no pleasure in it anymore. The trains just sit there half-built. Turning on a game is pointless. The feeling is just... gone.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or wishing you were dead?

I... um. I don't know. I guess... sometimes I think it might just be easier if I didn't wake up. It's... it's not like I have a plan or anything, but... the other day I caught myself looking through all my finances. Just... making sure everything was organized. Like I was getting it ready for... for someone else to handle. It kind of scared me.
Have you experienced any periods where you felt significantly better than you do now since this feeling of failure started?
No. I... I don't think so. It's just been pretty much the same. Since it started.
Are there any small things that still give you some joy, even if it's just for a moment?

I... no. Like I was saying before, I just... I don't get anything out of it anymore. Even the small stuff. I look at those half-built trains on the table and feel... nothing. Even trying to put a game on the TV with my daughter... it just feels completely pointless now. So... no.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how quickly you move since you started feeling this way?

I... yeah. I guess so. Just... everything takes a lot of effort now. Even simple things... like carrying the laundry upstairs, or... just sorting the mail. It feels like I'm moving through wet cement. And it doesn't really matter how long I've been in bed... it's just always like that.
Have you ever felt this low before in your life?
No. I... I don't think so. Not that I can remember, anyway. It's... never been like this before.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt depressed for more than two weeks before this current episode started?
No. I... I just said that. I've never felt like this before.
Have you ever had an episode like this before that lasted for a while and then got better?
No. I... I don't know how else to say it. Like I just told you... no. It's never happened before.
Do you think you would enjoy something if you were to do it right now, like watching a Cubs game or working on your model railway?

No. I don't think so. I used to... look forward to that kind of stuff. With my daughter. But... the trains are just sitting there on the table, half-built. I haven't touched them. And putting a game on the TV... it just feels pointless now.
Do you think something could happen in the future that would make you feel happy again?
I don't know. I... I can't really picture anything like that happening. It's hard to see that far ahead.
Have you experienced any significant weight loss or gain since you started feeling this way?

Lost some weight, I guess. I've had to... tighten my belt recently. I just don't really bother making a real meal most days. I'll forget to eat until it's late, and then... I only manage to have some toast or cereal. That's about it.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling this way?
No. I haven't... nothing like that. Just my own thoughts.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or restless, or do you feel like you're moving in slow motion most of the time?
I don't really know. I haven't... noticed anything like that. I mostly just sit in the same spot, so... I don't think I'm restless.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things like reading or watching TV since you started feeling this way?

I guess so. I used to... well, I used to manage engineering spreadsheets without even thinking about it. But lately... I just stare at a grocery list, or a bill. Half an hour will go by and I still can't... decide what to do next. It's just hard to think.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah. I guess so. I don't... really do much anymore. 

I used to like working on the model railway... watching Cubs games with my daughter. But lately, the trains just sit there half-built on the table. And the games... even turning it on the TV just feels pointless.
